PSNProfiles — grades and PSN progress counts (psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi)
OutputLag — visible vs hidden split, counts and methods (outputlag.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-list/)

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. It is always last, so plan around A Long Road (100% completion) instead of chasing the Platinum directly.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and it unlocks. There is nothing to prepare and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 1 and it pops. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter: the game has no mission replay, so a save is your only way back.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 2. Switching between Jason and Lucia opens after Breakfast Run in this chapter, which is also when the partner trophies become possible.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 3. Most robbery tools arrive in the middle of the game, so the crime trophies open up around this chapter.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 4. Bank vaults unlock through an optional mission near the end of this chapter, so plan vault runs from here on.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the final mission. After the credits you can keep exploring Leonida freely, and the 100% checklist opens, so nothing is locked behind the ending.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Breakfast Run mission in Chapter 2. Character switching opens right after it, which the partner trophies need.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Cartel Heist mission. It pops as part of the story, so just play the mission through.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Child's Play mission. No side work is needed for it.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Headliners mission. It unlocks in the course of the story.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the VCIA Takedown mission at Vice City International Airport. The airport is also where the Catch Me If You Can trophy happens, but that one needs a plane, not this mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission. It pops as part of the story.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion using the in-game checklist, which opens after the story under Progress. You do not need literally everything: for example 15 of the 18 collectible card sets count, and 70 of the 80 Challenges. Work you do before the credits still counts, so start the long grinds early.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts across Leonida: stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps. There are 397 in the game, so you need a little over half. 100% completion needs 300, so keep going past 250. Track them under Progress, and find spots on the map under Exploration.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Play one round of each of the nine activity types on the map. Open Activities on the map and work down the list; nothing here needs a win, just one try each.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers, and some are locked until you meet their conditions, which the map shows. Check progress under Activities.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Some charge an entry fee. Find them on the map under Activities, Drones, Top Fun Drones.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Winning the same race twice does not count, so move on to a new location after each win. Watch your car's Rating and upgrade at Mod Shops if you use your own car. Track them under Activities, Racing.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2kg. Fish in the marked area from a boat with a fishing rod until you land one big enough. Boats in the area can be taken if you do not own one.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four in-game arcade games. Any of them counts, so pick the one you find first and play it through.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish all of Andy's story missions. The trophy pops after his final mission. Andy's strand does not count toward the eight Strangers & Freaks strands, because it has its own trophy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish all of Kenton's missions, ending with the mission named Maritime Disputes. The trophy pops after that final mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish all of Billy's missions, ending with the mission named Hometown Heroes. The trophy pops after that final mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying Stranger mission strands across Leonida. Not every optional questline counts: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands have their own trophies and do not count here. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish all of Randy's missions. His strand includes a vehicle wish list to track down, and the trophy pops after his final mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish all of Tyrone's missions, which include the Kitty Litter Lab work. The trophy pops after his final mission. Like Andy's and Billy's strands, Tyrone's does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. A spot only counts once the final zen animation has played. Spots show as purple icons when you are close, and you can track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. MISSABLE WARNING: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter, and the game has no mission replay, so do it while you are still in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. This is the only trophy reported as possibly missable.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Work through Bret Vogel's hunting questline, which is Jason-only. You hunt animals through target decks; a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which the questline wants. The trophy pops when you take the unique animal Bret asks for.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Collect every card in 3 full sets. There are 18 sets in Leonida, and cards you collect can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count toward progress. For 100% completion you need 15 sets, so this pops along the way. Track cards under Progress, Collections.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the WAiNK app on your phone: landmarks, curiosities and sculptures around Leonida. Open the phone app with Up and scan a spot when prompted. Track progress under Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 Challenges. They are in-game feats listed under Progress, Challenges, and many complete on their own while you play. 100% completion needs 70, so keep going past 50.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted Level and then lose the cops and leave the red heat zone. The trophy only pops once you are out of the heat zone, not just out of the flashing search area. Bank vault jobs give you 4 stars at once, so this pairs well with Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so wait a moment before hitting a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. You discover one by getting inside it or by scanning it with the WAiNK app, so scan traffic as you drive. Track them under Progress, Vehicles. 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base models.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim: press L3 and R3 while aiming. Each fish you land adds about 10% to the Focus meter, and Adrenaline extends it. Pick a group of enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and take five down with an assault rifle in one Focus.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count, and the ones at gates E3 and E4 work. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. Fly about 1 km away from the airport and the trophy pops, after a delay. Save first: the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a military tank. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on Goose Key at the bottom of the Keys. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Chapter 3 job gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. If someone spots you, reload and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and get away. Vaults unlock through an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4, where you tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner: you cannot carry all the bags alone, and a vault job gives you 4 stars at once, which also sets up Hot Together. The 100% checklist needs all eight vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape with the take. Like the vault jobs, this one only pops once you have left the red heat zone, so keep driving until you are clear. Getting out of the flashing search area alone is not enough.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Reveal every region of the map. Drive, fly and walk into each part of the state until the map is filled in. It comes naturally while you work on the other exploration trophies, so leave it for the cleanup phase.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the nine gangs in Leonida. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way. Marked Bills from these jobs feed into Dime on the Dollar.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy it with the view. A small scenic moment: find a beachside spot, sit down with a drink, and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: In the Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car out through a vehicle showroom, smashing your way out in classic style. Pick a showroom, get a car inside or drive one in, then break out through the glass.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a proper follow-through: play a frame and finish the motion. The alley is the trigger, so a full game is not needed.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Train with your partner at a gym. The trigger reported by guides is both Jason and Lucia reaching maximum Strength, so buy a gym membership and train together, since your partner trains alongside you. This method is reported, not yet confirmed in the game.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Fill the Criminal Profile by doing things that change it: guides report that 500 profile-changing actions are needed, and robberies and fights feed it. It fills up without a separate grind while you play the crime trophies, so check your profile as you go. The exact count is reported, not yet confirmed in the game.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Hidden trophy with an unlock method that is not yet confirmed. Its name hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something, but no guide has pinned down the trigger yet. Keep an eye on the cited sources as players confirm it, and do not chase it until then.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Hidden trophy with an unlock method that is not yet confirmed. Its name hints at a surprising in-game moment, but no guide has pinned down the trigger yet. It will likely pop on its own while you play; check the cited sources once players confirm it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock enemies over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a group on foot and swing a melee weapon as you pass. It takes a steady hand at low speed, so use a quiet street and a slow car.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 of Marked Bills by selling them to your contacts. Marked Bills come from bank and payday loan jobs and from illegal operations. The total is cumulative across the whole game, so it builds up while you work on the other crime trophies.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative and counts every kind of shop, so it builds up naturally while you buy weapons, clothes, food and upgrades. Garages do not count here; this is shop spending only.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count. Each garage adds one parking spot, which the Scooter Bros registrations also need.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
trophies.name: On the Spot
